classification: dirty-tree signed-worker diagnostic; not release or five-family qualification
signing_scope: Apple Development signed worker bundle; parent recorded by executable SHA-256
implementation: Native parser-driven import-map registration after CSP authorization; normalized exact, prefix and scoped resolution stored per V8 context.
Existing and already-resolved mappings survive later map merges. Null/invalid entries and prefix traversal reject resolution.

Mapped resources share canonical module identity. Speculative loading no longer installs global aliases for equal relative paths in different directories or rejects roots for unused failed dynamic imports.
HTML event-handler imports use their realm's native document base; rejected dynamic imports carry native exception objects instead of strings.
Registered nonempty integrity entries explicitly reject until fetch-time SRI is integrated. This does not qualify dynamically inserted maps or integrity support generally.
Restored the missing locked-corpus build entrypoint, with per-framework logs, immutable served snapshots and before/after fixture-lock checks.
Added an all-framework OIL runner with exact state/action predicates, diagnostic traces, per-case deadlines and unchanged-artifact checks.

resource_limits.scope: Per realm; not agent-wide memory qualification.

javascript.scope: Run after the public native base-URL helper change; later changes were confined to oryn-native and its tests.

frameworks.scope: Declared framework-owned action/state outcomes and absence of script/console errors, not full routing/storage or persisted application workflows. Build identifiers prevent a byte-identical-build claim.

import_maps.lost_pass: no-referencing-script-integrity-valid.html: valid integrity imports are now rejected instead of bypassing the map. Positive SRI support remains missing.
import_maps.scope: Entire inventoried import-map group including variants. Failed cases with no assertion results remain in the 57-case denominator; not a full-WPT baseline.

oauth_next_track_probe.isolation: Streaming replay reaches the child authorization page; Approve has no successful action frame and emits worker-closed error. Later parent observation reads Authenticated with PKCE. This is a failed workflow despite the final text.
oauth_next_track_probe.root_cause_status: Suspected close-versus-in-flight-action lifecycle handling; a native fault is not established by a process-closed error alone.
oauth_next_track_probe.harness_gap: Noninteractive stdin mode prints the action error but exits zero; the --file runner correctly fails. Do not use process exit alone as success.

remaining: Repair OAuth child self-close/in-flight action handling and qualify all five controlled authentication cases with complete failure accounting.
Dynamic import-map preparation/Already Started and error events, import.meta.resolve, document.write/frame helper readiness, positive SRI and full module evaluation semantics remain incomplete.
Persisted authenticated SaaS, research/extraction and booking workflows; broader framework routing/storage outcomes.
Connected-window/worker architecture, full Core WPT and clean-source security/lifecycle/performance qualification.
